title: Media dropped into the History workspace vanishes (absorbed into MPI-454)
description: CLOSED 2026-08-21 as absorbed into MPI-454 - not built under this card. The brainstorm that redesigned MPI-454 into the Place tool made the drop one of THREE slot sources, so the drop routing became acceptance lines on that card rather than a job of its own. The fix this card originally proposed (build a history entry from the dropped file) was REJECTED by the user: an imported photo is not a generation and would pollute the group history. See tasks/MPI-454/brief.md. Original text preserved in brief.md.
acceptance: Dropping an image into the History workspace appends a visible history entry and loads it on the canvas
The dropped file still reaches generation as before - no regression to the existing chip staging
Video mode: dropping a start/end frame while the video prompt tool is active still unlocks the frame-driven i2v ops
Multi-file drops produce one entry per file, in drop order
A failed upload surfaces a toast instead of failing silently
The entry survives a reload - the group is persisted, not just appended in memory
